comment: Entry point 3 focuses on API exposure and openness. Adding APIs to a proprietary or poorly structured platform is not sufficient to achieve interoperability, maintainability, or supplier independence.

anchor.note: p.90 l.Lines 92-100 read as the printed page; section 4.2.1 agrees

public.text: Entry point 3 focuses on API exposure and openness. Adding APIs to a proprietary or poorly structured platform is not sufficient to achieve interoperability, maintainability, or supplier independence.
public.suggestedRevision: Require governed information models, semantic alignment, complete data export, interface rights, documentation, security, testability, configuration portability, and a credible supplier-exit path.
